reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin through tiered packages listing euro amounts and token allocations, while linking projected appreciation and a “very decent capital gain” to joining and submitting tokens for coin generation. It invites viewers to get started and claims that joining can produce profit and income, while using the founder’s credentials and technical explanations to bolster the pitch.

citations.quote: With a high demand, the expected value of a single OneCoin will, over the next couple of years, increase and we can expect a very decent capital gain.
Where you, by submitting your tokens, will be able to generate coins to your own personal account.
By joining the concept you not only profit from the cryptocurrency but also position yourself for the future economy.
Make sure to get your questions answered by the person who showed you this video and get started.

opening.argument: The projection is presented as scenarios, not as a promised result: the chart distinguishes an “Optimistic scenario” from a “Base scenario” (F0047). The narration likewise calls appreciation “expected” and says value “can” increase, language that describes a forecast rather than a guaranteed return. Read in that limited way, this is a speculative view of a new cryptocurrency, not proof that viewers were assured of a particular gain.

citations.quote: With a high demand, the expected value of a single OneCoin will, over the next couple of years, increase
if you are interested in building your portfolio and creating a profitable stream of income.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The tier graphic establishes that packages have different prices and token allocations, but it does not itself establish that a buyer was promised a return. And the two scenarios matter: a chart explicitly separating an optimistic case from a base case is not the same as presenting one guaranteed outcome. The narration's forecast is evidence of promotion, but a forecast alone does not establish deceptive certainty.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling outcomes scenarios does not undo the sales pitch surrounding them. The video predicts that OneCoin's value will increase and says viewers can expect capital gain, then ties participation to generating coins and getting started. The optimistic/base labels qualify a projection; they do not turn this into detached market analysis.

citations.quote: With a high demand, the expected value of a single OneCoin will, over the next couple of years, increase and we can expect a very decent capital gain.

opening.argument: Much of the narration teaches the underlying concept rather than walking viewers through a payment or purchase: it explains the blockchain as a public ledger, compares it with bank databases, and describes how copies are distributed across a network. It also places cryptocurrency in the broader context of banking, fees, and financial access. Those educational explanations are real content, even if the presentation later advocates for OneCoin; they do not by themselves establish that the technical explanation is false or that a viewer completed a transaction.

citations.quote: The interesting thing is that cryptocurrency is not a file on the computer it is rather an entry in the public distributed database called the blockchain.
Each user in the entire network has an identical copy and since the Blockchain is public it cannot be controlled by any person.

today billions of people are living without a bank account while many more have a smartphone that can give you access to a global personal banking system through the technology of cryptocurrency banking for everyone.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference points to package pricing and asks viewers to join, but that does not erase the substantial explanatory material about cryptocurrency and blockchain. A discussion can include a forecast and still contain genuine educational content. The cited excerpts do not show that the ledger explanation is itself a solicitation or that a viewer paid for a package.

citations.quote: The blockchain or the ledger of a cryptocurrency keeps a record of every coin and every transaction ever made
To hack the Blockchain, hackers would have to target thousands of computers across multiple geographic locations, all at the same time.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The technical explanation is used to support the specific OneCoin opportunity, not presented as the video's endpoint. After discussing the technology, the narration describes OneCoin's expected appreciation and instructs viewers how to participate, then urges them to get started. Educational passages do not neutralize that direct promotional arc.

citations.quote: With a high demand, the expected value of a single OneCoin will, over the next couple of years, increase and we can expect a very decent capital gain.
Make sure to get your questions answered by the person who showed you this video and get started.

opening.argument: The package graphic shows a range of priced tiers and corresponding token quantities, including a free tier; that is evidence of a commercial offer, but not by itself of a fraudulent mechanism (F0053). The supplied material does not establish that a viewer actually paid, received a guaranteed return, was asked for credentials, or earned income by recruiting others. The narration's claims about projected value deserve scrutiny, but the evidence distinguishes a sales pitch from proof of a completed purchase or realized gain.

citations.quote: To be part of OneCoin, you ever seen. Where you, by submitting your tokens, will be able to generate coins to your own personal account.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The price tiers show that the offer involves paid packages, but they do not establish that anyone bought one or that any gain was guaranteed or realized. The stated omission is important: the narration describes token submission and coin generation, but the cited material does not show a completed payment or a credential request. Projected appreciation makes the promotion worth examining; it does not fill those evidentiary gaps.

citations.quote: Where you, by submitting your tokens, will be able to generate coins to your own personal account.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A completed purchase is not required to identify what the video promotes. The graphic links tiered euro amounts with token allocations, and the narration connects participation to expected appreciation and capital gain. That combination makes the commercial mechanism central; the absence of evidence of a viewer's realized outcome does not negate the solicitation.
